**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. human life consists of a succession of small events each of which is

B. and yet the happiness and success of every man depends

C. comparatively unimportant

D. upon the manner in which these small events are dealt with
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"ACBD."**

• The sentence talks about the importance of dealing with small events in life.
 
• The subject of the sentence is **"human life"**, so the first part must be A.
 
• The next part must be C as it provides the predicate **"comparatively unimportant."**
 
• The next part of the sentence starts with B, as it is having **"and."**
 
• The sentence uses a complex sentence structure with multiple clauses.
 
• The next part must be D as it provides the object to the sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

**Correct sentence**: *H**uman life consists of a succession of small events each of which is comparatively unimportant, and yet the happiness and success of every man depends upon the manner in which these small events are dealt with.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Austin kept the cake in the refrigerator.

options.text: The cake is kept in the refrigerator by Austin.
The cake was kept in the refrigerator by Austin.
The cake was being kept by Austin in the refrigerator.
The cake was kept in the Austin by the refrigerator.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"The cake was kept in the refrigerator by Austin."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in the Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it intothe Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'Austin'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'cake'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• Kept' will be changed into 'was kpet'. 
 
• "Cake" is a singular subject and we must use "was" with it.
 
• The preposition "by" is used to indicate the doer of the action in the passive voice.
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 2.

 ​

Correct sentence: *The cake was kept in the refrigerator by Austin.*

**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in positive degree of comparison.**

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The peon will post the letter.

options.text: The letter has been posted by the peon.
The letter would have been posted by the peon.
The letter will be posted by the peon.
The letter is being posted by the peon.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"The letter will be posted by the peon."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Simple Future Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + will + V1 + object (Active Voice__)
 
• Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha will sing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
